purpose: Authoring reference pack; no curriculum or work-order regeneration
edition_note: OpenStax Chemistry is the 2015 edition, revision C-2015-002(03/17)-LC, not Chemistry 2e. Organic sections are from the current publisher-hosted Tenth Edition; the study guide is supplementary.
source_policy: Use for facts and transparent derivations. Syllabus and exclusions govern scope. Write original prose and figures. Do not copy exercises, explanations or source diagrams. Preserve source licences/attribution on source copies.
limits: Sources exceed NSSCAS scope; consult the frozen contract exclusions for each topic.
The textbook is not evidence of Namibia-specific marking rules.
Topic-level reference routes do not certify that every objective or claim has been independently verified.
The 2015 textbook predates the 2019 SI revision; use the current 2e mole section and syllabus conventions for amount-of-substance definitions and supplied constants.
